name: inventory-premium-readability
description: Check actual quiet Inventory chrome, semantic shared rarity, full text bounds and 14/12 rendered floors at 80/100/120 percent, readable rows, card/model reuse, state retention and full pet actions and actual Forest Pup face direction/eight-corner fit. Runs in the current real Studio viewport and records Camera+HUD sizes; Coordinator must run desktop and phone. Does not constitute aesthetic approval or physical-device performance.

steps.label: wait for ready profile and GUI

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
local world=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG')
assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'refusing non-ephemeral fixture')
assert(game.ServerStorage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids fixture')
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'profile must be ready ephemeral')
local function ownershipSettled(player)
 local pending=player:GetAttribute('PendingGamePassGrantCount')
 return player:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciled')==true
  and player:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed')==false
  and (pending==nil or pending==0)
end
local ownershipDeadline=os.clock()+20
repeat
 assert(p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed')~=true,'GamePass ownership reconciliation failed; fixture not safe')
 if ownershipSettled(p) then break end
 task.wait(.05)
until os.clock()>=ownershipDeadline
assert(ownershipSettled(p),'GamePass ownership not settled before fixture: '..H:JSONEncode({reconciled=p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciled'),failed=p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed'),pending=p:GetAttribute('PendingGamePassGrantCount')}))
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'reset failed')
assert(c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=150000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99}).ok==true,'seed failed')
local names={'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
for i=2,#names do assert(c:Invoke('BuyFist',names[i]).ok==true,'buy failed '..names[i]) end
assert(c:Invoke('EquipFist',names[1]).ok==true,'equip starter failed')
for _,name in ipairs({'Forest Pup','Forest Pup','Miner Cat'}) do assert(c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name=name,stars=1}).ok==true,'pet seed failed') end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,firstFive=names,seedMode='EphemeralStudio',ownershipSettled=ownershipSettled(p),pendingGamePassGrants=p:GetAttribute('PendingGamePassGrantCount') or 0})

steps.label: seed five fists and three pet tokens only in ephemeral Studio

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local P=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.PolishConfig)
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local GS=game:GetService('GuiService')
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
local function assertRequestedScale(requested)
 local actual=a:Invoke('Snapshot')
 assert(type(actual)=='table' and actual.ok==true and type(actual.uiScale)=='number' and math.abs(actual.uiScale-requested)<.001,'actual client Snapshot.uiScale did not retain requested scale '..tostring(requested))
 return actual
end
local function setScale(requested)
 local applied=a:Invoke('SetSettings',{uiScale=requested,persist=false})
 assert(type(applied)=='table' and applied.ok==true and type(applied.uiScale)=='number' and math.abs(applied.uiScale-requested)<.001,'SetSettings did not return requested actual scale '..tostring(requested))
 return assertRequestedScale(requested)
end
local first={'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
local function rgb(c)return {math.round(c.R*255),math.round(c.G*255),math.round(c.B*255)}end
local function sameColor(a,b)return math.max(math.abs(a.R-b.R),math.abs(a.G-b.G),math.abs(a.B-b.B))<=1/255 end
local function visible(x)
 local n=x
 while n and n~=player.PlayerGui do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end
 return x:IsDescendantOf(player.PlayerGui)
end
local function inside(x,y)
 local p,s,q,t=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,y.AbsolutePosition,y.AbsoluteSize
 return p.X>=q.X-1 and p.Y>=q.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y+1
end
local function fits(label,floor,scale)
 assert(label.TextScaled==false,'critical text uses shrink-to-fit '..label:GetFullName())
 assert(label.TextSize*scale>=floor-.01,'rendered text floor '..label:GetFullName())
 assert(label.TextFits and label.TextBounds.X<=label.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and label.TextBounds.Y<=label.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,'actual text clipped '..label:GetFullName()..' '..label.Text)
end
local function cardByKey(grid,key)
 for _,c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren())do if c:IsA('GuiObject') and c:GetAttribute('InventoryKey')==key and c.Visible then return c end end
 error('missing actual card '..key)
end
local function definition(name)for _,d in ipairs(G.Fists)do if d.name==name then return d end end error('missing config '..name)end
local function verifyPupPresentation(viewport, model)
 assert(viewport.CurrentCamera and model,'Pup viewport/model missing')
 local face
 for _,x in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
  if x:IsA('Decal') and x.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and x.Transparency<1 and x.Parent:IsA('BasePart') and x.Parent.Name=='AnimatedFace' then face=x break end
 end
 assert(face and face.Texture=='rbxassetid://2759037468','retained Pup face texture missing or changed')
 local camera=viewport.CurrentCamera
 local part=face.Parent
 local center=part.CFrame.Position+part.CFrame.LookVector*part.Size.Z*.5
 local signed=part.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(camera.CFrame.Position-center)
 assert(signed>.05,'Pup camera is behind actual retained decal: '..tostring(signed))
 local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
 local vp=viewport.AbsoluteSize
 assert(vp.X>0 and vp.Y>0,'Pup viewport must have actual dimensions')
 local tanV=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local maxNdc,minDepth=0,math.huge
 for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
  local corner=camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*x,size.Y*y,size.Z*z)*.5))
  local depth=-corner.Z
  local nx=math.abs(corner.X)/(depth*tanV*vp.X/vp.Y)
  local ny=math.abs(corner.Y)/(depth*tanV)
  assert(depth>.05 and nx<=1/1.12+.001 and ny<=1/1.12+.001,'Pup actual eight-corner inset failed')
  maxNdc=math.max(maxNdc,nx,ny);minDepth=math.min(minDepth,depth)
 end end end
 return {faceDot=signed,maxNdc=maxNdc,minDepth=minDepth,faceTexture=face.Texture,viewport={vp.X,vp.Y}}
end
local samples={}
a:Invoke('OpenInventory')
a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All')
a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','')
a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists')
task.wait(.5)
local r=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory
local w=r.InventoryWindow
local body=w.InventoryBody
local pane=body.InventoryGridPane
local grid=pane.InventoryGrid
local search=pane.InventoryToolbar.InventorySearch
local oldScale=tonumber(r:GetAttribute('InventoryUIScale')) or 1
local ok,result=pcall(function()
 for _,requested in ipairs({.8,1,1.2})do
  setScale(requested)
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists')
  GS.SelectedObject=nil
  task.wait(.35)
  local actualSettings=assertRequestedScale(requested)
  local scale=w.InventoryScale.Scale
  local compact=r:GetAttribute('InventoryCompact')==true
  assert(math.abs(scale-requested)<.001,'settings did not apply requested scale')
  assert(inside(w,r),'modal outside supplied safe host')
  assert(sameColor(w.BackgroundColor3,Color3.fromRGB(18,26,38)) and sameColor(w.InventoryHeader.BackgroundColor3,Color3.fromRGB(18,26,38)),'wrong common shell')
  local stroke=w:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke')
  assert(stroke and stroke.Thickness==1 and sameColor(stroke.Color,Color3.fromRGB(61,88,101)),'outer border is not quiet')
  for _,x in ipairs(w:GetDescendants())do
   if x.Name:match('^InventoryFrameBrace') or x.Name=='InventoryWindowInnerFrame' or x.Name=='InventoryWindowTopRail' or x.Name=='InventoryWindowBottomRail' or x.Name=='HeaderPattern' or x.Name=='HeaderTopHighlight' or x.Name=='HeaderBottomRail' or x.Name=='HeaderGoldEdge' or x.Name=='GridPaneTopRail' then
    assert(not visible(x),'decorative chrome visible '..x.Name)
   end
  end
  local rows={}
  for _,name in ipairs(first)do
   local c=cardByKey(grid,'fist:'..name)
   local d=definition(name)
   local label=c.ItemName
   fits(label,14,scale)
   fits(c.ItemRarity,12,scale)
   assert(inside(label,c) and inside(c.ItemRarity,c),'card text bounds '..name)
   assert(math.abs(c.AbsoluteSize.Y-(compact and 92 or 104))<1.1,'actual row height '..name)
   assert(c.AbsoluteSize.X>=279,'actual readable column width '..name)
   assert(c.ItemRarity.Text==string.upper(d.rarity) and sameColor(c.ItemRarity.BackgroundColor3,P.RarityColors[d.rarity]),'semantic rarity mismatch '..name)
   local art=c.ItemArtFrame
   assert(art.AbsolutePosition.X+art.AbsoluteSize.X<=label.AbsolutePosition.X+.5,'art overlaps name')
   assert(not c.CardFooterRail.Visible and not c.CardInnerFrame.Visible and not c.RarityAccent.Visible,'decorative card rails visible')
   rows[#rows+1]={name=name,width=c.AbsoluteSize.X,height=c.AbsoluteSize.Y,text=label.TextSize*scale,rarity=rgb(c.ItemRarity.BackgroundColor3)}
  end
  local firstCard=cardByKey(grid,'fist:'..first[1])
  local beforeModel=firstCard:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true)
  beforeModel=beforeModel and beforeModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WorldModel')
  local catalog=beforeModel and beforeModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
  assert(catalog and catalog:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==first[1],'shared first fist preview missing')
  local creates=r:GetAttribute('InventoryCardCreateCount')
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','fist:'..first[1])
  task.wait(.25)
  local detail=body.InventoryDetail
  assert(visible(detail) and inside(detail,body),'detail or drawer bounds')
  assert(sameColor(detail.DetailRarity.BackgroundColor3,P.RarityColors.Common),'detail rarity mismatch')
  local selectedStroke=firstCard:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke')
  assert(selectedStroke and sameColor(selectedStroke.Color,Color3.fromRGB(22,203,255)) and selectedStroke.Thickness==2,'selection not cyan')
  assert(r:GetAttribute('InventoryCardCreateCount')==creates and cardByKey(grid,'fist:'..first[1])==firstCard and catalog.Parent==beforeModel,'selection rebuilt cards or preview')
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists')
  GS.SelectedObject=nil
  task.wait(.3)
  grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.min(60,math.max(0,grid.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-grid.AbsoluteSize.Y)))
  task.wait(.3)
  local savedCanvas=grid.CanvasPosition
  local savedKey=r:GetAttribute('InventorySelectedKey')
  local savedSearch=search.Text
  setScale(requested)
  task.wait(.35)
  assertRequestedScale(requested)
  assert((grid.CanvasPosition-savedCanvas).Magnitude<1 and r:GetAttribute('InventorySelectedKey')==savedKey and search.Text==savedSearch,'same-state refresh changed view')
  a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','__no_match_inventory_visual_qa__')
  task.wait(.2)
  assert(visible(pane.InventoryEmptyState),'empty search feedback missing')
  fits(pane.InventoryEmptyState.InventoryEmpty,12,scale)
  assert(inside(pane.InventoryEmptyState.InventoryEmpty,pane.InventoryEmptyState),'actual no-results text bounds')
  a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','')
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets')
  task.wait(.3)
  local petCard
  for _,x in ipairs(grid:GetChildren())do
   local preview=x:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true)
   if x:IsA('GuiObject') and x.Visible and preview and preview:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName')=='Forest Pup' then petCard=x break end
  end
  assert(petCard,'Forest Pup card missing')
  local pupViewport=petCard:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true)
  local pupWorld=pupViewport:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WorldModel')
  local pupModel=pupWorld and pupWorld:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
  assert(pupModel and pupModel:GetAttribute('InventoryPreview')==true and pupModel:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')=='Forest Pup','Pup catalog preview identity')
  local pupCardProof=verifyPupPresentation(pupViewport,pupModel)
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem',petCard:GetAttribute('InventoryKey'))
  task.wait(.3)
  local pupDetail=detail:FindFirstChild('DetailPetPreview',true)
  local pupDetailWorld=pupDetail and pupDetail:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WorldModel')
  local pupDetailModel=pupDetailWorld and pupDetailWorld:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
  local pupDetailProof=verifyPupPresentation(pupDetail,pupDetailModel)
  a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem',petCard:GetAttribute('InventoryKey'))
  task.wait(.15)
  assert(pupModel.Parent==pupWorld and pupDetailModel.Parent==pupDetailWorld,'Pup selection rebuilt actual model')
  local actionCount=0
  for _,x in ipairs(detail.DetailActions:GetChildren())do
   if x:IsA('TextButton') and x.Visible then
    assert(x.AbsoluteSize.X>=43.5 and x.AbsoluteSize.Y>=43.5 and inside(x,detail.DetailActions),'actual pet action bounds')
    fits(x,12,scale)
    actionCount+=1
   end
  end
  assert(actionCount==4,'expected full pet action set')
  assert(r:GetAttribute('InventoryEnabledActionContrastPass')==true and (r:GetAttribute('InventoryMinimumEnabledActionContrast') or 0)>=4.5,'actual action palette contrast')
  samples[#samples+1]={scale=scale,snapshotScale=actualSettings.uiScale,compact=compact,rows=rows,actions=actionCount,pupCard=pupCardProof,pupDetail=pupDetailProof,window={w.AbsoluteSize.X,w.AbsoluteSize.Y},camera={workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y},safeHUD={g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.AbsoluteSize.X,g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.AbsoluteSize.Y}}
 end
 return {ok=true,samples=samples,proof='ActualInstancesTextBoundsColorsAndState',aestheticApproval=false}
end)
local restored,restoreError=pcall(setScale,oldScale)
a:Invoke('CloseInventory')
assert(ok,'inventory premium readability failed: '..tostring(result)..' '..H:JSONEncode(samples))
assert(restored,'failed to restore actual original uiScale: '..tostring(restoreError))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
